capabilities: Render tab panels from a tabs code block in Live Preview and Reading mode
Open a chosen tab automatically by marking it as the default
Index links, headings and tags inside tab panels with an experimental cache
Edit tab content by clicking it in Live Preview
extras: The cache and editing features are explicitly marked experimental, with warnings to back up the vault; the README lists known issues with nested code blocks, footnotes and read-only content.
problem: Obsidian renders all note content stacked in one flow and has no built-in way to split content into switchable tab sections.

relations.evidence: Syntax was inspired by Obsidian HTML Tabs, made by ptournet
Plugins like Dataview can query and use data within tab panels.

summary: Renders tabbed content sections inside notes from a tabs code block, with optional cache integration and click-to-edit content.
